Messages.Author: François Alix
Messages.Body:
Just to be sure...
- Can a Renegade Garou equip with a Pier 13 ?
- Can a Talaq equip with a Pier 13 ?
- In general, which allies can play blood-costing cards ?
- And then, if possible, which cards can be played in this manner
(disciplineless ?)
Thanks

François Alix, Toreador Primogen of Paris

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From "François Alix" <al...@club-internet.fr> =====

>Just to be sure...
>- Can a Renegade Garou equip with a Pier 13 ?

He can't pay the blood cost. If you can move the Pier (by stealing it from
another Methuselah via Disputed Territory, for instance), then you could
place
it on the Garou.

>- Can a Talaq equip with a Pier 13 ?

As Garou above.

>- In general, which allies can play blood-costing cards ?

No, since they cannot pay the cost.
